result:
Good, confirmed the action layer routes through `issue-service.updateIssue`, which now validates label ids. All fixes are in place and the full test suite (617 tests) passes with no type errors.

Summary of the fixes made, all at the service layer (where cross-workspace/live/membership checks belong):

- **`src/server/repositories/member-repository.ts`**: added `isActiveMember(orgId, userId)`, the single source of truth for "is this a current member" (mirrors the existing `resolveActor` check).
- **`src/server/services/issue-service.ts`**: `createIssue` now validates `assigneeId` is an active member, `parentId` resolves to a live issue in the *same project* (org-scoped lookup naturally refuses cross-workspace and nonexistent parents as not-found), and `labelIds` all belong to the org's own labels. `updateIssue` validates `labelIds` the same way. `assignIssue` validates the assignee is an active member.
- **`src/server/repositories/label-repository.ts`**: `listLabelsForIssues` now also scopes the join on `labels.orgId`, so a label row from another workspace can never render on an issue even if a stale join row exists.
- **`src/server/services/project-service.ts`**: `createProject`/`updateProject` validate `leadId` is an active member.
- **`src/server/services/comment-service.ts`**: `createComment` validates a reply's `parentId` is a live, top-level comment on the same issue (rejects replies to another issue's comment, deleted comments, and replies-to-replies). `resolveMentionedUsers` now filters both body-parsed and composer-supplied mention ids down to current active members, so a departed member's id from the composer is silently dropped rather than notified.
